final:
The three models now total about 3.29 MB, down from 19.81 MB, and `src/viewer.js` is updated to load them. I haven't run the page in a browser or built it. I did check each model with `node-assets inspect --against`, which renders it next to the original.

| Model | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `boombox.glb` | 10.61 MB | 0.46 MB |
| `helmet.glb` | 3.77 MB | 1.58 MB |
| `toycar.glb` | 5.42 MB | 1.24 MB |

- **Settings:** I used meshopt geometry compression and AVIF textures at the default quality. Triangle counts and texture sizes are unchanged.
- **Decoder cost:** The only decoder is meshopt, about 6 KB. The viewer now imports `MeshoptDecoder` from `three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js` and registers it on the loader. AVIF needs no extra files, because the browser decodes it and three's `GLTFLoader` already handles the extension.
- **Quality:** The render check reports a worst-region similarity score of 0.905 for the boombox, 0.96 for the helmet and 0.984 for the toycar. The tool treats 0.9 or higher as no visible loss. The boombox is close to that limit, so I didn't lower texture quality any further.
- **Alternatives I tried:**
  - WebP with meshopt came to 5.6 MB.
  - KTX2 with meshopt came out larger than the originals for the helmet (10.3 MB), and it would also have needed a Basis transcoder.
- **Browser support:** AVIF textures need a browser that decodes AVIF. That is all current major browsers, but older ones would fail to load these models.

The optimized files are in `public/models/`. The sources in `assets/` are untouched.
bash_cmds: ls -la . assets public public/models src; node-assets --help; cat src/viewer.js
node-assets optimize --help; node-assets inspect assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb; cat package.json

mkdir -p /tmp/o/a /tmp/o/b /tmp/o/c; for v in "a --geometry meshopt" "b --geometry meshopt --texture-format avif" "c --geometry meshopt --texture-format ktx2"; do set -- $v; d=$1; shift; node-assets optimize assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/o/$d/ --force "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $d "$@"; ls -l /tmp/o/$d | awk '{print $5,$9}'; done

until [ -s /tmp/claude-0/*/tasks/b52jsoa3u.output ] && grep -q "^c " /tmp/claude-0/*/tasks/b52jsoa3u.output && [ $(ls /tmp/o/c | wc -l) -ge 3 ]; do sleep 3; done; sleep 5; cat /tmp/claude-0/*/tasks/b52jsoa3u.output; ls -l /tmp/o/*
cd /tmp/o; node-assets inspect b/ --against ~/../$OLDPWD/assets 2>&1 | head -40; kill %1 2>/dev/null; true

cp /tmp/o/b/*.glb public/models/ && python3 - <<'E'
p='src/viewer.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { OrbitControls","import { MeshoptDecoder } from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';\nimport { OrbitControls",1)
s=s.replace("const loader = new GLTFLoader();","const loader = new GLTFLoader();\nloader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
ls -l public/models; grep -n -i meshopt src/viewer.js
